summary: Completed public API and frontend regression testing for dashboard, navigation, CRUD modals, pricing, and mobile layout.

integration_issues.issue: Orders page modal posts to /api/transactions because TablePage.add has no isOrders branch; created order is absent from the orders table.

action_items: Fix the orders modal to POST order payloads to /api/orders and verify the new record appears in Siparişler.
critical_code_review_comments: Stat data-testid values contain an extra closing brace, reducing reliable testability.
Dashboard quick-add and notification controls have no handlers; either implement them or mark them non-interactive.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed materials, product, sale, and order records through public APIs; UI test material and failed UI order repro were also submitted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard, all five navigation routes, material modal, mobile menu, no-horizontal-overflow, and pricing API passed. Re-test order creation after fixing the endpoint branch.
rca of the issue: TablePage.add handles materials and products, then falls through to transactions for every other type. Since orders are represented by a separate /api/orders collection, type==='orders' must call that endpoint instead.
